A data row with more cells than the header widens the separator so no cell is silently dropped

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td><td>3</td></tr></table>")
IO.inspect(result)
```
